verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a transcription API, since batch transcription or bulk management of many files is something such a product could ship, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented batch or bulk capability: the CLI transcribes one file per command, its pipe-friendly output only lets users write their own loops, and the Zapier/Make/n8n integrations are third-party automation platforms. None of these is the product's own bulk-operation feature.
